cds.title: Dickinson College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF form, Analytics & Institutional Research)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set 2025-2026 (G1, G5): tuition $71,100, required fees $550 (the all-undergraduates column prints $55, which looks like a typo), on-campus food and housing $18,650 (housing $9,600 + meal plan $9,050). Estimated expenses for residents: books and supplies $1,324 and other expenses $1,718; transportation is printed as a range ($300-1,200), so no 'other' total is shown and the CDS prints no total cost. Aid (CDS H6, final 2024-25 data): institutional need-based and non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 221 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received it, an average of $58,593 (total $12,949,004). Nonresident first-year aid applicants file the college's own form and the International Student's Certification of Finances (H7); the admissions site also asks for the CSS Profile. The international aid page says mandatory health insurance ($2,500) and one-time fees of $125 are not covered by Dickinson aid.

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class, from the Common Data Set (C1, C2, C9, C21), read from the PDF's form fields. Residency rows (in-state 1,068 / out-of-state 3,102 / international 1,549 applicants; 539 / 1,626 / 208 admitted; 135 / 314 / 36 enrolled) add up to the totals (5,719 / 2,373 / 485) and the male + female + unknown counts match. The ED figures (454 applications, 258 admitted) cover Early Decision (ED I and ED II together). The CDS reports no early action plan for that class; the admissions site now lists Early Action for fall 2027. Test scores are optional (Dickinson has been test-optional since 1994): 13% of enrolled first-years (65) submitted the SAT and 4% (17) the ACT, so the percentile ranges describe the submitters only. Dickinson left the high-school GPA tables (C11, C12) blank, so no GPA is shown; 49% of first-years were in the top tenth of their class and 81% in the top quarter (C10, 28% of students supplied class rank). Undergraduate enrollment (2,140) and the nonresident count (257) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures from B1 and B2 (225 nonresidents are degree-seeking).
